name: 94112 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94112 (San Francisco) has 188 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94112 (San Francisco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
